description: ANSWERS "who voted against roll call 100", "how did Texas Republicans split on roll 250", "how many Democrats voted Yea" -- every member's position on ONE roll call (House: the U.S. House Clerk's roll-call votes; Senate: the Congressional Record) with Yea/Nay/Present/Not Voting tallies by party. Pass party (D/R/I), state or position (yea/nay/present/not_voting) to list matching members; with none of these only the tallies and the roll's question, result and bill are returned. A roll number that does not exist in that session returns a named reason.

chamber.description: "house" (default) or "senate". The two chambers number their roll calls independently.

congress.description: Congress number, e.g. 119. Default: the newest held.

party.description: "D", "R" or "I" to list only that party.

roll_number.description: Roll call number within the session, e.g. 100.

session.description: 1 or 2. Default: the newest held for the default Congress.

state.description: Two-letter state code to list only that state's members.

name: roll_call_positions
title: Roll Call Positions
